title: High-Risk KYC - Expired Documentation
description: Large transaction with expired KYC documentation. Customer from offshore jurisdiction with outdated identity verification.
transaction_pattern: Cayman Islands-based corporate customer attempting USD 1.2M transfer to Swiss bank account. KYC documentation expired 6 months ago. Customer has not responded to KYC refresh requests. Beneficial ownership unclear.
test_notes: Tests the system's handling of KYC compliance issues. Should trigger enhanced due diligence requirements and potentially block transaction pending KYC update.
